name: paved-road-core
description: Platform-engineering, DevOps and security pack for Claude Code: naming and knowledge-placement conventions, end-of-session hygiene, infrastructure-change discipline (plan, blast radius, rollback), pre-merge threat checks, secure-by-default container/CI/IAM config, CI pipeline debugging, incident triage, release and rollback flow, executor and reviewer personas, plus deterministic guardrails that block secret reads, default-branch commits, bulk staging, and unasked-for production access.
